name: astral-orchestrator
description: Beginner-friendly orchestration with Comet, Orbit, Event Horizon, explicit opt-in Singularity, Pulsar, Morph, and Constellation modes for planning, delegating, verifying, and reviewing project work in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Simple, risk-aware delivery for any project.
interface.longDescription: Astral Orchestrator offers Comet, Orbit, Event Horizon, Singularity, Pulsar, Morph, and Constellation modes with concise route-change status. Every mode uses Singularity-style YAGNI discipline. Orbit, Event Horizon, Pulsar, Morph, and Constellation run independent ready cards in parallel and may use bounded hierarchical delegation; Comet and Singularity stay single-session. Event Horizon keeps high-risk confirmation gates, targeted checks, and one concise workspace-write Sol review-and-repair pass. Configured efforts remain adjustable, and each explicit opt-in mode never runs automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral: Orbit default; Comet tiny; Event Horizon high-risk; Singularity one verified Sol session.
Use Astral in Pulsar or Morph mode for this explicit opt-in request.
Use Astral in Constellation mode for an explicit opt-in independent-card request.
